messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "ingredient causing serious side effects or death in very young or premature babies"
set: ["ingredient causing serious side effects or death in very young or premature babies", "dangerous side effects or death", "serious or life-threatening side effects", "premature babies", "serious side effects", "serious side effects that could lead to death", "no side effects identified in breastfed babies", "serious side effects from overdose", "taking too much may cause serious or life-threatening side effects", "may cause serious side effects in a nursing baby", "newborn or premature baby", "fatal side effects", "gastrointestinal side effects", "illness causing vomiting or diarrhea", "stomach side effects", "Sexual side effects"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
